options.text: Everything Claude keeps in mind during this session
options.explanation: Correct. Messages, files and the results of commands all take up space in the context.

options.text: All the sessions you’ve ever had with Claude
options.explanation: Claude can’t see the conversations of earlier sessions. That’s why lasting instructions are written in CLAUDE.md.

options.text: The folder where the project is
options.explanation: The folder is where the project lives. The context is the session’s “desk”.

questions.question: You’re moving on to a completely new task, and Claude has started going round in circles. What do you do?

options.text: I start a new session with the + New button in the sidebar
options.explanation: Exactly. A clean context often helps right away, and CLAUDE.md tells Claude the project’s basics again.

options.text: I keep going in the same session forever
options.explanation: A session that runs too long fills up the context, and Claude’s work gets worse.
There’s nothing wrong with the app. A new session is enough.
